subject: Bluetooth pairing glitch with Galaxy S26 Ultra
emailBody:

(Model: SM-S938B).

The phone is physically in perfect condition, but I keep running into a
frustrating *software* *glitch*. The *Bluetooth* sees my devices, but when
I try to *pair* them, it hangs on the *settings* screen and immediately

I do not want to send this in for a physical repair. Please provide the
official manual steps on *how to* reset the network settings or clear the
Bluetooth cache so I can resolve this software bug myself.

Thank you, Shubham Customer ID: CUST10001 Purchase Date: 2026-02-15

subject: S-Pen Air Actions keep disconnecting on Galaxy S26 Ultra
emailBody:
Hi Support Team,

I am writing to report an issue with my new Samsung Galaxy S26 Ultra
(Model: SM-S938B).

While the phone itself is working fine, I am having a frustrating problem
with the S-Pen. It writes on the screen perfectly, but the "Air Actions"
feature constantly disconnects. Whenever I take the pen out to use the
button as a camera remote or to control my music, the phone throws an
"S-Pen disconnected" error.

I keep putting it back into the phone to reconnect it, but the Bluetooth
connection drops again within 10 minutes.

Since the pen still writes, I feel like this might just be a software
glitch or a setting I need to change. Can you please provide me with the
exact steps to reset the S-Pen or fix this connection issue? I really don't
want to send the whole phone in for a repair if I don't have to.

Looking forward to your guidance.

Regards, Shubham Customer ID: CUST10001 Purchase Date: 2026-02-15

subject: Samsung S26 Ultra WiFi and Battery Issue - CUST10001
emailBody:
Dear Samsung Support,

I am writing to formally raise a complaint regarding my Samsung Galaxy S26
Ultra.

Customer ID   : CUST10001
Product       : Samsung Galaxy S26 Ultra
Model Number  : SM-S938B
Purchase Date : 2025-06-15

Issue:
My Galaxy S26 Ultra has been experiencing severe WiFi dropout and battery
drain
over the past 2 weeks. The phone disconnects from WiFi every 10-15 minutes
and
requires a manual reconnect. Additionally, the battery drains from 100% to
20%
within 4 hours of normal use, which is far below the expected performance.

I have already tried restarting the device but the issue persists. I would
like
this investigated and a repair or replacement arranged under warranty.

Regards,
Shubham
Customer ID: CUST10001
